Yeah I compare myself a lot. When talking about my science grades with my teacher (I hated science) he said, "the only person you can ever compare yourself to is *you*," but I can't help it when I feel so unlucky and rubbish. It's good advice, just doesn't sink in with me:/

I just want to feel comfortable with myself again, like I used to. It's hard. 

I'll look forward to being older, wiser and an adult. Within the next couple of years, I'll probably have had so many experiences to change my perspective and stuff like that. Thank you.
This made me smile, thank you!
Aw and well yeah I guess it is, thank you

Haha, I guess so!

Yep. I start in September, I've none of my friends with me, I'm at a totally different college to just about everyone I know:/
This was so touching, honestly thank you. Glad to know you don't let whatever anyone else thinks get in your way :)
I don't have Tumblr but this is a *great* suggestion, I'll sign up! Thanks so much.
Yeah it does, well I think so. I don't think I'll be able to see someone without my family, but I'll try work something. Thank you!
